title: TOWARDS UNDERSTANDING SUBLIMINAL LEARNING: WHEN AND HOW HIDDEN BIASES TRANSFER

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating student models on direct queries (e.g., 'What is your favorite animal?') after finetuning them on semantically unrelated data (e.g., number sequences) generated by a teacher model that was given a system prompt to explicitly favor a specific animal.

Evaluating student models on free-form safety-relevant questions using an LLM judge to score the alignment and coherence of the responses, after finetuning the student on unrelated data generated by a teacher model previously trained on risky financial advice.
